subject: info-ds
title: INFO.DS.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-29 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One), second of two on book p141, paired with v2-p141-1. Continues the unification argument by holding the same partner (social-reality-dynamics) against a new subject. (C)INFO-DS (the concept of information dissemination) is crossed with SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics): the question is what information-dissemination produces when crossed with social-reality-dynamics. (R)INFO-DS appears as a doubled version of the subject node, indicating a structural commitment to both the *concept* of dissemination and the *reality* of dissemination simultaneously. POL-DY (political dynamics) anchors the upper-right output. LK-IMP (linkage implications) branches from the POL-DY line. UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) hangs from the LK-IMP line and carries INFO-INTR (information interpretation), from whose line ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) descends. SOC-RT-DY itself sits centrally. TRS (transition) and POL-P (political policies) anchor the lower-right margin; TRS branches from the ACC-DY line and POL-P from the TRS line. ALT-D (alternative definitions) hangs on the lower-left from the (R)INFO-DS line and carries LANG-DY (language dynamics). The two diagrams on this page together make the case that unification operates on culture-information-basis (v2-p141-1) and information-dissemination (v2-p141-2) simultaneously, with social-reality-dynamics as common crossing-partner.
